399-cast-upon-the-breakers.title: Cast Upon The Breakers
399-cast-upon-the-breakers.creator: Horatio Alger, Jr.
399-cast-upon-the-breakers.description: A book by Horatio Alger, Jr.. The boarding school of which Rodney was, as his friend expressed himself, a star pupil, was situated about fifty miles from the city of New York. It was under the charge of Dr. Sampson, a tall, thin man of fair scholarship, keenly alive to his own interest, who showed partiality for his richer pupils, and whenever he had occasion to censure bore most heavily upon boys like David Hull, who was poor.

arxiv-2102-08081.title: A Lazy Approach for Efficient Index Learning
arxiv-2102-08081.creator: Guanli Liu, Lars Kulik, Xingjun Ma, Jianzhong Qi
arxiv-2102-08081.description: Abstract . Learned indices using neural networks have been shown to outperform traditional indices such as B-trees in both query time and memory. However, learning the distribution of a large dataset can be expensive, and updating learned indices is difficult, thus hindering their usage in practical applications.

arxiv-2102-09613.title: Relativistic Ermakov-Milne-Pinney Systems and First Integrals
arxiv-2102-09613.creator: Fernando Haas
arxiv-2102-09613.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Fernando Haas. The Ermakov-Milne-Pinney equation is ubiquitous in many areas of physics that have an explicit time-dependence, including quantum systems with time dependent Hamiltonian, cosmology, time-dependent harmonic oscillators, accelerator dynamics, etc. The Eliezer and Gray physical interpretation of the Ermakov-Lewis invariant is applied as a guiding principle for the derivation of the special relativistic analog of the Ermakov-Milne-Pinney equation and associated first integral. The special relativistic extension of the Ray-Reid system and invariant is obtained. General properties of the relativistic Ermakov-Milne-Pinney are analyzed.

arxiv-2104-09822.title: Superconductivity in ThMo 2 Si 2 C with Mo 2 C Square Net
arxiv-2104-09822.creator: Zichen Liu, 1 Baizhuo Li, 2 Yusen Xiao, 1 Qingchen Duan, 1 Yanwei Cui, 3 YuXue Mei 1 Qian Tao, 2 Shuli Wei, 1 Shugang Tan, 1 Qiang Jing, 1 Qing Lu, 1 Yuping Sun, 1 Yunyan Liu, 1 Shenggui Fu, 1 Hao Jiang, 4 Zhi Ren, 3 Zhu’an Xu, 2 Cao Wang, 1 Guanghan Cao. 2
arxiv-2104-09822.description: Abstract We report the superconductivity of a new quaternary compound ThMo 2 Si 2 C, synthesized with the arc-melting technique. The compound crystallizes in a tetragonal CeCr 2 Si 2 C-type structure with cell parameters of a a = 4.2296 Å and c c = 5.3571 Å. An interlayer Si–Si covalent bonding is suggested by the atomic distance.

arxiv-2112-06848.title: Peer-to-Peer Communication Trade-Offs for Smart Grid Applications
arxiv-2112-06848.creator: Purboday Ghosh 1 , Shashank Shekhar 2 , Yashen Lin 3 , Ulrich Muenz 2 , Gabor Karsai 1
arxiv-2112-06848.description: Abstract Virtual topologies in peer-to-peer networks can reduce the traffic consumed by altering the logical connectivity of peers without altering the underlying network. However, such sparsely connected virtual topologies do not focus on the needs for smart grid applications, which is information dissemination throughout the network, and in turn degrade the performance of distributed control algorithms running on peer-to-peer networks.

arxiv-2202-03151.title: Generalized Yang-Mills Theory under Rotor Mechanism
arxiv-2202-03151.creator: B.T.T.Wong
arxiv-2202-03151.description: Abstract This paper follows the previous work on generalized abelian gauge field theory of higher-order derivatives under rotor model and extends the study to the most generalized non-abelian case. We find that the rotor mechanism from the abelian case applies nicely to the non-abelian case under the Lorentz gauge condition.

arxiv-2402-18081.title: Dynamics Around the Earth-Moon Triangular Points in the Hill Restricted 4-Body Problem
arxiv-2402-18081.creator: Luke T. Peterson, Gavin Brown, Àngel Jorba, Daniel Scheeres
arxiv-2402-18081.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Luke T. Peterson, Gavin Brown, Àngel Jorba, Daniel Scheeres. This paper investigates the motion of a small particle moving near the triangular points of the Earth-Moon system. The dynamics are modeled in the Hill restricted 4-body problem (HR4BP), which includes the effect of the Earth and Moon as in the circular restricted 3-body problem (CR3BP), as well as the direct and indirect effect of the Sun as a periodic time-dependent perturbation of the CR3BP.

arxiv-2406-17790.title: Mashee at SemEval-2024 Task 8: The Impact of Samples Quality on the Performance of In-Context Learning for Machine Text Classification
arxiv-2406-17790.creator: Areeg Fahad Rasheed, M. Zarkoosh
arxiv-2406-17790.description: Abstract Within few-shot learning, in-context learning (ICL) has become a potential method for leveraging contextual information to improve model performance on small amounts of data or in resource-constrained environments where training models on large datasets is prohibitive. However, the quality of the selected sample in a few shots severely limits the usefulness of ICL.

arxiv-2512-06512.title: A New Torus Generator for AGAMA
arxiv-2512-06512.creator: James Binney Tom Wright, Eugene Vasiliev
arxiv-2512-06512.description: Abstract Code is presented that computes and exploits orbital tori for any axisymmetric gravitational potential. The code is a development of the agama software package for action-based galaxy modelling and can be downloaded as the agama b code library. Although coded in C++, most of its functions can be accessed from Python.

pmc-10618896.title: Strengthening the evidence to improve health outcomes of children with perinatal HIV exposure
pmc-10618896.creator: Sonia Lee, Susannah Allison, Pim Brouwers
pmc-10618896.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). IntroductionThe number of children exposed to HIV and possibly to antiretroviral therapy (ART) in utero and during breastfeeding and are uninfected (HEU) globally will continue to increase from the estimated 15.9 million in 2021.DiscussionThere are still significant gaps in our understanding of the impact of HIV and/or ART exposure in children who are HEU, in terms of prevalence/incidence and severity on health and wellbeing, and long after exposure has ended.

pmc-11387810.title: Perceptions of a naloxone leave behind program among emergency medical services personnel in Michigan, USA
pmc-11387810.creator: Jason Brian Gibbons, Olivia K. Sugarman, Lauren Byrne, Samantha J. Harris, Hridika Shah, Eric G. Hulsey, Julie Rwan, Esther Mae Rosner, Anthony Pantaleo, Emily Bergquist, Brendan Saloner
pmc-11387810.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). IntroductionIn 2020, Michigan implemented its first Naloxone Leave-Behind Program for Emergency Medical Service (EMS) field providers. Under the program, EMS field providers leave naloxone kits to individuals aged 15 or older they encounter in the field who have overdosed, who indicate they have a substance use disorder, or exhibit signs of opioid use and/or to bystanders, friends, or family that are present at the encounter.MethodsSurvey of EMS field providers and administrators to assess perspectives on the Michigan NLB program.

pmc-11537187.title: Atypical Presentation of Choroidal Osteoma: Two Case Reports
pmc-11537187.creator: Dafne Fernandes Machado, Stela Souza Peña, Mariana Carneiro Alves, Giovana Capecci Siqueira, Leonardo Amarante Pereira, Samantha Sanches de Carvalho, Thais Moura Gascon, Beatriz da Costa Aguiar Alves, Glaucia Luciano da Veiga, Fernando Luiz Affonso Fonseca, Vagner Loduca Lima, Priscilla Ballalai
pmc-11537187.description: Choroidal osteoma is a rare, benign, osseous choristoma presenting as an orange-yellow, well-defined fundus mass. It presents unilaterally in most cases, has a predilection for the female sex, and favor a juxtapapillary location, becoming clinically manifest when it involves the macula. Almost 60% of eyes with osteoma may suffer significant visual loss.

pmc-11676130.title: Tunnel Infection and Peritonitis Induced by Staphylococcus aureus Due to Decubitus Change of the Anterior Abdominal Wall in a Patient on Peritoneal Dialysis: Case Report
pmc-11676130.creator: Marko Baralić, Ana Bontić, Jelena Pavlović, Vidna Karadžić-Ristanović, Selena Gajić, Jovan Jevtić, Pavle Popović, Kristina Petrović, Lara Hadži-Tanović, Aleksandra Kezić
pmc-11676130.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The occurrence of anterior abdominal wall ulcer at the site of the peritoneal catheter (PC) is one of the rarest complications of peritoneal dialysis (PD). When present, it is mainly caused by staphylococci which respond well to vancomycin therapy. Despite well-conducted therapy, there is a tendency to relapse and induce peritonitis, which makes it necessary to remove the PC and change the dialysis model of treatment and/or re-insert the catheter at another place to preserve PD as a treatment method.

pmc-12551009.title: The safety of herbal medicines in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs): current landscape and promoting the pharmacovigilance practices
pmc-12551009.creator: Muhammad Akhtar Abbas Khan, Madiha Khalid, Obaidullah Malik
pmc-12551009.description: About eighty-eight percent of people worldwide rely on traditional and complementary medicine for their primary healthcare needs, with many pharmacies in developed countries offering plant-based over-the-counter medications. However, the increasing use of medicinal products, especially when combined with pharmaceuticals, poses health risks that are often underreported, particularly in low- and middle-income countries.

pmc-12691251.title: FABP3 Mediates Lipid Droplet Accumulation and Adhesive Capacity in Bovine Endometrial Epithelial Cells via PGE2/PTGER4/PPAR Axis
pmc-12691251.creator: Beibei Zhang, Yutong Yan, Ming Cheng, Tengfei Guo, Kangkang Gao, Aihua Wang, Pengfei Lin, Dong Zhou, Yaping Jin, Gianluca Neglia
pmc-12691251.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Simple SummaryTo investigate the function of PGE2 on endometrial function during the diestrus period and its mechanisms, bovine endometrial epithelial cells (bEECs) were treated with P4 or P4 + PGE2. Results showed that PGE2 treatment promoted the accumulation of lipid droplets and induced cytoskeletal reorganization; the PPAR signaling pathway was the key pathway, and its downstream target gene FABP3 was markedly up-regulated; FABP3 knockdown reduced the adhesion of bovine trophoblast cell (BTC) spheroids to bEECs and down-regulation of adhesion-related proteins in bEECs

pmc-13133192.title: Mach-Zehnder atom interferometry with non-interacting trapped Bose-Einstein condensates
pmc-13133192.creator: T Petrucciani, A Santoni, C Mazzinghi, D Trypogeorgos, F S Cataliotti, M Inguscio, G Modugno, A Smerzi, L Pezzè, M Fattori
pmc-13133192.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The coherent manipulation of a quantum wave is at the core of quantum sensing. For instance, atom interferometers require splitting and recombination processes to map the accumulated phase shift into a measurable population signal. Although Bose-Einstein condensates (BECs) are the archetype of coherent matter waves, their manipulation in double-well potentials has been limited by the strong interparticle collisions dominating over the tunneling energy.

pmc-13380800.creator: Tyler R Johnson, Crispin Foli, Emily C Conlan, Katherine A Koenig, Mark J Lowe, William D Memberg, Robert F Kirsch, Eric Z Herring, Stanley F Bazarek, Emily L Graczyk, Dawn M Taylor, A Bolu Ajiboye, Jennifer A Sweet
pmc-13380800.description: This study aimed to improve intracortical microelectrode array implantation sites for grasp-related motor decoding by integrating anatomical, functional, and vascular imaging with preoperative 3D modeling.A participant with C5 tetraplegia underwent anatomical MRI, diffusion-weighted imaging, and task-based fMRI to identify grasp-related cortical regions while avoiding vasculature and speech-critical areas.

pmc-13681242.creator: Naoise Webb, Hannah O'Daly, Christine Linehan
pmc-13681242.description: AimsThis review explored how health and social care staff engage in sexuality‐related conversations with adults with intellectual disabilities.MethodElectronic databases (PsycINFO, MEDLINE, CINAHL and Scopus) were searched from January 2006 to August 2025 following PRISMA guidelines. From the initial 1666 studies identified, a total of 23 were retained for narrative synthesis following quality assessment.

uslaw-usc-t16-s973e.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 16C (South Pacific Tuna Fishing). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Prohibited acts A person is guilty of a criminal offense if he or she commits any act prohibited by paragraph (6), (8), (9), or (10) of section 973c(a) of this title. (b) Sentence and fine Any offense described in subsection (a) of this section.
